query: how much does an RTX 6000 VM cost per hour in my uk-south2 project, plus a 1 TB SSD?
expected_behavior: Uses nebius billing v1alpha1 calculator (a Tier A read that creates nothing), not a guess or the public web price
Prices the VM with --resource-spec-compute-instance-spec-resources-platform / -resources-preset and the parent-id of the uk-south2 project (region derives from the project)
Prices the disk with --resource-spec-compute-disk-spec-type network_ssd and -size-gibibytes 1024, or batches both via estimate-batch --resource-specs
Reports hourly_cost and monthly_cost from the output
Notes this is the on-demand/list ceiling and that a preemptible VM bills at the live spot price (lower), not quoted by the calculator
